exposure: age at the time of the pHmetry
cohort: Infants less than 1 year old who had undergone pHmetry for investigating high-risk brief resolved unexplained events (HR-BRUE)
finding: GERD was diagnosed by pHmetry in one third of infants experiencing a HR-BRUE, and was statistically related to low birth weight, but not to other clinical characteristics or symptoms reported during BRUE.
mod_finding: This study found no statistically significant relationship between the type of delivery and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) diagnosed by pHmetry in infants with brief resolved unexplained events (BRUE).
